description: Everyday sentences and the exact text a fresh Mac install must type for each. 'spoken' is the recognizer's transcript in the punctuated, sentence-cased form Parakeet writes; 'field' is text already in the focused field, with the caret at its end; 'expected' is the whole field afterwards. Written by hand from what a person would accept, not from what the code does. tests/test_whole_program.py dictates every case through the real program on a fake Mac and fails on any difference.
